purpose: Hermetic client harness matrix for hosted MCP keyless/account-door behavior. Commands must use temporary HOME/XDG/CODEX/Claude directories and local mock URLs only.

keyless_200_with_prm.expected: client connects without automatic browser OAuth; PRM presence alone is inert

bare_401_with_json_body.expected: client must not be used as a recovery channel because bodies are client-dependent and may be swallowed

oauth_challenge_401.expected: client enters OAuth flow only on the account door or after user-initiated login

tool_level_recovery.expected: structuredContent.next_actions is visible to the model/client

commands.claude_add_keyless: HOME=$TMP_HOME XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$TMP_HOME/.config CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$TMP_HOME/.claude claude mcp add --scope user --transport http firecrawl-local http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v2/mcp
commands.claude_login_keyless_no_browser: HOME=$TMP_HOME XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$TMP_HOME/.config CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$TMP_HOME/.claude claude mcp login --no-browser firecrawl-local
commands.codex_add_keyless: CODEX_HOME=$TMP_HOME/.codex HOME=$TMP_HOME XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$TMP_HOME/.config codex mcp add firecrawl-local --url http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v2/mcp
commands.codex_login_keyless: CODEX_HOME=$TMP_HOME/.codex HOME=$TMP_HOME XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$TMP_HOME/.config codex mcp login firecrawl-local

expected_assertions: No command reads or writes the real HOME, ~/.claude, ~/.codex, or project .mcp.json
Request logs redact Authorization, cookies, code_verifier, state, and token-like query params before persistence
A 200 initialize response never causes an automatic browser OAuth flow
A transport 401 body is not the recovery contract; tool-level structuredContent is the recovery contract
User-initiated login requires published PRM metadata for the configured endpoint
